# expitf

> Compute the [standard logistic][logistic-function] function for a single-precision floating-point number.

<section class="intro">

The [standard logistic][logistic-function] function, also called the expit function, inverse logit, or sigmoid function, is defined as the [logistic][logistic-function] function with parameters (`k = 1`, `x0 = 0`, `L = 1`).

```math
\begin{aligned}\mathop{\mathrm{expit}}(x) &= \frac{1}{1+e^{-x}} \\ &= \frac{e^{x}}{e^{x}+1} \\ &= \frac{1}{2} + \frac{1}{2}\tanh\frac{x}{2} \end{aligned}
```

</section>

<!-- /.intro -->

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```javascript
var expitf = require( '@stdlib/math/base/special/expitf' );
```

#### expitf( x )

Computes the [standard logistic][logistic-function] function for a single-precision floating-point number.

```javascript
var v = expitf( 0.0 );
// returns 0.5

v = expitf( 1.0 );
// returns ~0.731

v = expitf( -1.0 );
// returns ~0.269

v = expitf( Infinity );
// returns 1.0

v = expitf( -Infinity );
// returns 0.0

v = expitf( NaN );
// returns NaN
```

</section>

<!-- /.usage -->

<section class="examples">

## Examples

<!-- eslint no-undef: "error" -->

```javascript
var uniform = require( '@stdlib/random/array/uniform' );
var logEachMap = require( '@stdlib/console/log-each-map' );
var expitf = require( '@stdlib/math/base/special/expitf' );

var opts = {
    'dtype': 'float32'
};
var x = uniform( 100, 0.0, 1.0, opts );

logEachMap( 'expitf(%0.4f) = %0.4f', x, expitf );
```

</section>

<!-- /.examples -->

<!-- C usage documentation. -->

<section class="usage">

### Usage

```c
#include "stdlib/math/base/special/expitf.h"
```

#### stdlib_base_expitf( x )

Computes the [standard logistic][logistic-function] function for a single-precision floating-point number.

```c
float out = stdlib_base_expitf( 0.0f );
// returns 0.5f

out = stdlib_base_expitf( 1.0f );
// returns ~0.731f
```

The function accepts the following arguments:

-   **x**: `[in] float` input value.

```c
float stdlib_base_expitf( const float x );
```

</section>

<!-- /.usage -->

<!-- C API usage examples. -->

<section class="examples">

### Examples

```c
#include "stdlib/math/base/special/expitf.h"
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <stdio.h>

int main( void ) {
    float x;
    float v;
    int i;

    for ( i = 0; i < 100; i++ ) {
        x = (float)rand() / (float)RAND_MAX;
        v = stdlib_base_expitf( x );
        printf( "expitf(%f) = %f\n", x, v );
    }
}
```

</section>
